For the last five years and change, I've been working on a geofictional/micronational government simulation called the Safirian Empire, based in the Micras Sector. Safiria is a sprawling, multispecies star empire, with thousands of member worlds and over 40 billion in-universe citizens; first among equals, however, are the safir — a race of four-armed blue-blooded and -skinned psionic elflike humanoids — and their homeworlds of Daia and Lessa.

We're currently in the middle of a reboot and could really use more participants!

Presently, we're four years (one in-game year is a real-life month) into a six-year term of the mainland Parliament, headed by a left-wing coalition of three parties. All parties desperately need players; most of them have zero. :(

Not interested in Safirian politics? That's okay; there are plenty of other ways you could take part:

  • Administration — Safiria is looking for devoted, talented, and responsible administrators and moderators to assist in running the game and its universe, and all the simulations inherent thereto.
  • Diplomacy — There are a lot of other micronations like Safiria, and we could really use people devoted to the furtherance of strong diplomatic relations with those micronations, as well as fresh views on Safirian foreign policy.
  • The Military — Safiria is a veeery large star empire, as I said earlier, and needs a large military (especially a large starfleet) to maintain its borders and hold its enemies at bay. Essentially, you'd be helping build the Safirian Forces, develop the weapons, vehicles, vessels, etc. Safiria would use if and when the time comes — and when that time does come, rare though it may be, help us fight and beat the enemy.

How do I create a character? Sign up for a forum account, then apply for citizenship (sign into the game) over here. Just remember: you can't claim any titles you don't have, so you can't start as the Grand Duchess of Kickassia or a field marshal or suchlike. ;) (http://safiria.cu.cc/forum/new-board/%28read-me-second%29-creating-your-character/))

TL;DR — Safiria desperately needs active and committed players to get the game off the ground. I could also use the help of partner admins to help in running the game and all the moving parts that come with it.
